source: 儿童版已有可运行副本；故事、阵容与塔层为网页改编

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 晨光落在石阶上。塔门缓缓打开，守塔人放下手中的书。
story.en: Morning light falls on the stone steps. The tower door opens, and the keeper puts down a book.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 你为什么来到这里？为了赢过别人，还是遇见更勇敢的自己？
story.en: Why are you here? To beat others, or to become a little braver?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我想试一试，慢慢进步。
story.en: I want to try and get better.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 第一步不必很大，愿意尝试就很好。
story.en: Your first step can be small. It is good to try.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会小心，也会照顾朋友。
story.en: I will be careful and help my friends.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 这座塔有10层。今天走到哪里都没关系，记住你学到的东西。
story.en: This tower has 10 floors. It is all right to stop. Remember what you learn.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我准备好了，先走一步。
story.en: I am ready to take the first step.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 守塔人点亮了第一阶的蓝灯。新的试炼，从一句勇敢的回答开始。
story.en: The keeper lights the first blue lamp. A new trial begins with a brave answer.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 夜色落进营地，最后一盏巡夜灯也暗了。草丛里传来细小的脚步声。
story.en: Night falls over the camp. The last watch light goes out. Small footsteps rustle in the grass.

story.speaker: 营地向导
story.text: 别怕，是我。你愿意陪我找回灯里的光吗？
story.en: Do not be afraid. It is me. Will you help me find the light?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我在这里。我会帮助你。
story.en: I am here. I will help you.

story.speaker: 营地向导
story.text: 谢谢。听，桥那边有铃声。我们要慢慢走，别惊醒小动物。
story.en: Thank you. Listen! A bell is ringing across the bridge. Let us walk slowly.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们一起过桥吧。
story.en: Let us cross the bridge together.

story.speaker: 营地向导
story.text: 守卫把光藏在了门后。门一打开，我来点灯，你照顾大家。
story.en: The guard hid the light behind the door. I will light the lamp. Please keep everyone safe.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会保护大家。
story.en: I will keep everyone safe.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 两人的影子沿着小路前进。黑暗里，一点蓝光回应了他们。
story.en: Two shadows move down the path. A tiny blue light answers them in the dark.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 练习课结束后，一颗小火种滚进裂隙。它的光正在变弱。
story.en: After class, a little spark rolls into a crack. Its light is fading.

story.speaker: 火种看守
story.text: 我听见火种在哭。它不是想烧东西，它只是迷路了。
story.en: I can hear the spark crying. It does not want to burn anything. It is lost.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 别害怕，我们来帮你。
story.en: Do not be afraid. We are here to help.

story.speaker: 火种看守
story.text: 裂隙里很热。你拿着水壶，我拿着灯，我们互相照应。
story.en: It is hot inside. You take the water. I will take the lamp. We can help each other.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 给你一些水。
story.en: Here is some water for you.

story.speaker: 火种看守
story.text: 前面的守卫不肯让路。救出火种后，要把它送回课堂。
story.en: The guard will not let us pass. After we save the spark, we must take it back to class.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们会带你回家。
story.en: We will take you home.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 火种闪了两下。它听见了那句“回家”，终于不再发抖。
story.en: The spark flashes twice. It hears the word home and stops shaking.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 海风落在石阶上。塔门缓缓打开，守塔人放下手中的书。
story.en: Sea breeze falls on the stone steps. The tower door opens, and the keeper puts down a book.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 你为什么来到这里？为了赢过别人，还是遇见更勇敢的自己？
story.en: Why are you here? To beat others, or to become a little braver?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我想试一试，慢慢进步。
story.en: I want to try and get better.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 登得再高，也别忘了帮后来的人照亮阶梯。
story.en: However high you climb, leave a light for others.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会小心，也会照顾朋友。
story.en: I will be careful and help my friends.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 这座塔有20层。今天走到哪里都没关系，记住你学到的东西。
story.en: This tower has 20 floors. It is all right to stop. Remember what you learn.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我准备好了，先走一步。
story.en: I am ready to take the first step.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 守塔人点亮了第一阶的蓝灯。新的试炼，从一句勇敢的回答开始。
story.en: The keeper lights the first blue lamp. A new trial begins with a brave answer.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 宝库深处闪着微弱的灯光。每亮三下，就停一会儿，像是在求救。
story.en: A weak light flashes deep in the vault. Three flashes, then a pause. Someone needs help.

story.speaker: 宝库侦察员
story.text: 这不是宝石的光。那是守库人的求救灯，我们不能走开。
story.en: That is not a jewel. It is the keeper asking for help. We cannot leave.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 有人需要我们的帮助。
story.en: Someone needs our help.

story.speaker: 宝库侦察员
story.text: 门上的三把锁会依次亮起。先看清楚，再一起行动。
story.en: Three locks light up one by one. Watch carefully. Then we will act together.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 先等一下，仔细看。
story.en: Wait a moment. Look carefully.

story.speaker: 宝库侦察员
story.text: 里面的守卫很强。宝物可以等，救人最重要。
story.en: The guard inside is strong. The treasure can wait. We must save the keeper first.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 先救人，再找宝物。
story.en: Let us save the keeper first.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 灯又亮了三下。这一次，门外也亮起了回应的光。
story.en: The light flashes three times again. This time, a light outside answers it.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 一片羽毛落在梦里的湖上。湖水没有倒影，只有一声轻轻的呼唤。
story.en: A feather lands on a lake in a dream. There is no reflection, only a quiet call.

story.speaker: 梦境引路人
story.text: 那是我的羽毛。少了它，我就找不到醒来的路。
story.en: That is my feather. Without it, I cannot find my way out of this dream.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会帮你找到路。
story.en: I will help you find the way.

story.speaker: 梦境引路人
story.text: 梦里会出现很多假羽毛。真正的那片，会随着心跳发光。
story.en: There are many false feathers here. The real one glows with each heartbeat.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 听，是心跳的声音。
story.en: Listen. That is a heartbeat.

story.speaker: 梦境引路人
story.text: 如果我忘记自己是谁，请叫我的名字。不要让我一个人留下。
story.en: If I forget who I am, please call my name. Do not leave me here alone.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我不会把你留下。
story.en: I will not leave you behind.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 湖面泛起一圈光。梦中的旅人记住了这个声音。
story.en: A ring of light spreads across the lake. The dreamer remembers that voice.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 火光落在石阶上。塔门缓缓打开，守塔人放下手中的书。
story.en: Firelight falls on the stone steps. The tower door opens, and the keeper puts down a book.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 你为什么来到这里？为了赢过别人，还是遇见更勇敢的自己？
story.en: Why are you here? To beat others, or to become a little braver?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我想试一试，慢慢进步。
story.en: I want to try and get better.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 勇敢不是不害怕，而是害怕时仍知道怎样照顾自己。
story.en: Being brave means taking care of yourself, even when you are afraid.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会小心，也会照顾朋友。
story.en: I will be careful and help my friends.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 这座塔有30层。今天走到哪里都没关系，记住你学到的东西。
story.en: This tower has 30 floors. It is all right to stop. Remember what you learn.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我准备好了，先走一步。
story.en: I am ready to take the first step.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 守塔人点亮了第一阶的蓝灯。新的试炼，从一句勇敢的回答开始。
story.en: The keeper lights the first blue lamp. A new trial begins with a brave answer.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 金库的风铃不见了。没有铃声，山谷里的送货鸟纷纷迷路。
story.en: The vault wind chime is gone. Without its sound, the delivery birds are getting lost.

story.speaker: 火鸟信使
story.text: 小偷没有拿金币，只拿走了风铃。我们得先弄清为什么。
story.en: The thief left the coins and took only the chime. We need to find out why.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们先听听他的故事。
story.en: Let us hear his story first.

story.speaker: 火鸟信使
story.text: 你看，地上有一条拖痕，通向那扇铜门。
story.en: Look! There is a mark on the ground. It leads to the bronze door.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 线索就在这里。
story.en: The clue is right here.

story.speaker: 火鸟信使
story.text: 如果守卫拦路，我们一起面对。拿回风铃，也要问清缘由。
story.en: If the guard stops us, we will face it together. We will bring back the chime and ask what happened.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们会把风铃带回来。
story.en: We will bring the chime back.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 远处传来一声轻响。那不是风，是风铃在等待回答。
story.en: A soft note rings far away. It is not the wind. The chime is waiting for an answer.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 夜里的山谷越来越冷，营地的篝火却突然变成了蓝色。
story.en: The valley grows cold at night. Suddenly, the campfire turns blue.

story.speaker: 守夜队长
story.text: 火没有熄灭，是有人把温暖锁住了。帐篷里的孩子还在睡。
story.en: The fire is still burning, but someone has locked away its warmth. The children are asleep.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们要让大家暖和起来。
story.en: We must keep everyone warm.

story.speaker: 守夜队长
story.text: 四个人要互相照看。你守住小路，我去找干柴。
story.en: We must look after each other. Watch the path while I find dry wood.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 放心，我会守住这里。
story.en: Do not worry. I will stay here.

story.speaker: 守夜队长
story.text: 前面的影子带走了火光。让我们在天亮前把它找回来。
story.en: That shadow took the firelight. Let us bring it back before morning.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 天亮前，我们一起回来。
story.en: We will come back together before morning.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 守夜人添上最后一根木柴。小小的暖光，为归来的人留着。
story.en: The watcher adds the last piece of wood. A small warm light waits for their return.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 霜雪落在石阶上。塔门缓缓打开，守塔人放下手中的书。
story.en: Frost and snow falls on the stone steps. The tower door opens, and the keeper puts down a book.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 你为什么来到这里？为了赢过别人，还是遇见更勇敢的自己？
story.en: Why are you here? To beat others, or to become a little braver?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我想试一试，慢慢进步。
story.en: I want to try and get better.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 冰上留下的每个脚印，都是一次认真选择。
story.en: Every footprint on the ice is a careful choice.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会小心，也会照顾朋友。
story.en: I will be careful and help my friends.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 这座塔有50层。今天走到哪里都没关系，记住你学到的东西。
story.en: This tower has 50 floors. It is all right to stop. Remember what you learn.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我准备好了，先走一步。
story.en: I am ready to take the first step.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 守塔人点亮了第一阶的蓝灯。新的试炼，从一句勇敢的回答开始。
story.en: The keeper lights the first blue lamp. A new trial begins with a brave answer.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 一封回信冻在冰层里。信封上写着：“我会在春天回来。”
story.en: A letter is frozen in the ice. On it are the words: I will come back in spring.

story.speaker: 雪原邮差
story.text: 这是给山下奶奶的信。她每天都在窗边等，可邮路被风雪封住了。
story.en: This letter is for a grandmother in the village. She waits by her window, but snow blocks the road.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们会把信送到。
story.en: We will deliver the letter.

story.speaker: 雪原邮差
story.text: 不要敲碎冰块，信纸会受伤。先找暖石，让冰慢慢融化。
story.en: Do not break the ice. It may damage the letter. Find a warm stone and let the ice melt slowly.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 慢慢来，小心一点。
story.en: Take your time. Be careful.

story.speaker: 雪原邮差
story.text: 冰门后的守卫听不懂我的话。请站在我身边，我们一起守住这封信。
story.en: The guard behind the ice gate will not listen. Stay beside me. We will protect the letter together.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我就在你身边。
story.en: I am right beside you.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 冰下的字渐渐清晰。远方的约定，终于有了走向家门的路。
story.en: The words become clear under the ice. A promise from far away has found its way home.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 风暴把罗盘的指针转个不停。只有风眼里，传来规律的滴答声。
story.en: The storm keeps spinning the compass needle. Only the eye of the storm holds a steady ticking sound.

story.speaker: 观风学者
story.text: 别追着指针跑。闭上眼睛，听听哪边的声音最清楚。
story.en: Do not chase the needle. Close your eyes. Where is the sound clearest?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我听见右边有声音。
story.en: I can hear a sound on the right.

story.speaker: 观风学者
story.text: 对。我们沿着石墙走，风大的时候就停下来。
story.en: Yes. Let us follow the stone wall. Stop when the wind is too strong.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 风太大了，我们先停下。
story.en: The wind is too strong. Let us stop.

story.speaker: 观风学者
story.text: 找到罗盘的心，我们就能让船安全靠岸。准备一起进去吗？
story.en: Find the heart of the compass and the ships can come home safely. Are you ready?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 准备好了，我们一起走。
story.en: I am ready. Let us go together.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 滴答声越来越近。四个人的脚步，终于有了同一个方向。
story.en: The ticking grows closer. Their footsteps now share one direction.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 流沙落在石阶上。塔门缓缓打开，守塔人放下手中的书。
story.en: Shifting sand falls on the stone steps. The tower door opens, and the keeper puts down a book.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 你为什么来到这里？为了赢过别人，还是遇见更勇敢的自己？
story.en: Why are you here? To beat others, or to become a little braver?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我想试一试，慢慢进步。
story.en: I want to try and get better.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 走得快不一定走得远。累了，就停下来喝口水。
story.en: Fast steps do not always take you far. Rest and drink when you are tired.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会小心，也会照顾朋友。
story.en: I will be careful and help my friends.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 这座塔有70层。今天走到哪里都没关系，记住你学到的东西。
story.en: This tower has 70 floors. It is all right to stop. Remember what you learn.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我准备好了，先走一步。
story.en: I am ready to take the first step.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 守塔人点亮了第一阶的蓝灯。新的试炼，从一句勇敢的回答开始。
story.en: The keeper lights the first blue lamp. A new trial begins with a brave answer.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 绿洲的水门紧紧关着。最后一把钥匙，被埋在了沙下的旧城。
story.en: The oasis water gate is locked. The last key lies in an old city under the sand.

story.speaker: 绿洲守望者
story.text: 水只够喝一天了。我们要找钥匙，但不能浪费路上的每一滴水。
story.en: We have water for only one more day. We must find the key and save every drop.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们一起节约用水。
story.en: Let us save water together.

story.speaker: 绿洲守望者
story.text: 墙上有一片叶子的图案。钥匙不是金色的，是绿色的。
story.en: There is a leaf on the wall. The key is not gold. It is green.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们要找绿色的钥匙。
story.en: We are looking for the green key.

story.speaker: 绿洲守望者
story.text: 开门后，先让最小的树喝到水。它已经等了很久。
story.en: When the gate opens, let the smallest tree drink first. It has waited a long time.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 先把水留给小树。
story.en: Let us give the little tree water first.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 一片干叶从门缝飘出。它还保留着一点点绿色。
story.en: A dry leaf drifts through the gate. A little green still remains.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 沙海里有人呼唤你的名字。回过头，却只看见一串旧脚印。
story.en: Someone calls your name in the desert. You turn around and see only old footprints.

story.speaker: 遗迹记录员
story.text: 不是每个回声都可信。跟着我的灯，不要追着声音走。
story.en: Not every echo is true. Follow my lamp. Do not follow the voices.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会跟着你的灯。
story.en: I will follow your lamp.

story.speaker: 遗迹记录员
story.text: 如果我们走散，就说约好的话：星星在上面，朋友在身边。
story.en: If we lose each other, say our secret words: Stars above, friends beside us.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 星星在上面，朋友在身边。
story.en: Stars above, friends beside us.

story.speaker: 遗迹记录员
story.text: 前面的门只会为真实的声音打开。把你的话说清楚。
story.en: The door ahead opens only for a real voice. Speak clearly.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 是我，我来找你了。
story.en: It is me. I am here to find you.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 这一次，沙海没有重复那句话。门后传来一声真正的回应。
story.en: This time, the desert does not echo. A real voice answers from behind the door.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 月光落在石阶上。塔门缓缓打开，守塔人放下手中的书。
story.en: Moonlight falls on the stone steps. The tower door opens, and the keeper puts down a book.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 你为什么来到这里？为了赢过别人，还是遇见更勇敢的自己？
story.en: Why are you here? To beat others, or to become a little braver?

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我想试一试，慢慢进步。
story.en: I want to try and get better.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 黑暗不会因为你闭眼而消失，但朋友可以陪你面对。
story.en: Closing your eyes will not end the dark. A friend can face it with you.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会小心，也会照顾朋友。
story.en: I will be careful and help my friends.

story.speaker: 守塔人
story.text: 这座塔有100层。今天走到哪里都没关系，记住你学到的东西。
story.en: This tower has 100 floors. It is all right to stop. Remember what you learn.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我准备好了，先走一步。
story.en: I am ready to take the first step.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 守塔人点亮了第一阶的蓝灯。新的试炼，从一句勇敢的回答开始。
story.en: The keeper lights the first blue lamp. A new trial begins with a brave answer.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 浓雾吞没了航标，船上的灯在沼泽深处徘徊。
story.en: Thick mist hides the beacon. Ship lights wander deep in the marsh.

story.speaker: 夜航领航员
story.text: 船长看不见岸。我们要找到三个灯座，让蓝光连成一条路。
story.en: The captain cannot see the shore. We must find three lamps and make a path of blue light.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们来照亮回家的路。
story.en: Let us light the way home.

story.speaker: 夜航领航员
story.text: 脚下很软，踩着石头走。看到同伴落后，就等一等。
story.en: The ground is soft. Step on the stones. Wait if a friend falls behind.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我会等你，不要着急。
story.en: I will wait for you. Take your time.

story.speaker: 夜航领航员
story.text: 最后一座灯台就在守卫身后。我们一起点亮它。
story.en: The last lamp is behind the guard. Let us light it together.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 大家一起，点亮航标。
story.en: Together, let us light the beacon.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 雾里响起船笛。那艘迷路的船，还没有放弃等待。
story.en: A ship horn sounds in the mist. The lost ship is still waiting.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 这里的钟永远停在午夜。有人握着半条手绳，在梦里等一个朋友。
story.en: The clock here is always at midnight. Someone holds half a friendship bracelet and waits in a dream.

story.speaker: 守梦人
story.text: 梦魇会学朋友的声音。别只听它说什么，要记住真正的约定。
story.en: The nightmare can copy a friend’s voice. Remember your real promise.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我答应过，不会离开。
story.en: I promised I would not leave.

story.speaker: 守梦人
story.text: 如果你看见两扇门，选有晨光的那扇。我们约好了在清晨相见。
story.en: If you see two doors, choose the one with morning light. We promised to meet at dawn.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 我们在清晨相见。
story.en: We will meet at dawn.

story.speaker: 守梦人
story.text: 谢谢你还记得。现在握紧手绳，我们一起走到梦的尽头。
story.en: Thank you for remembering. Hold the bracelet. Let us reach the end of the dream together.

story.speaker: 我
story.text: 无论多远，我们一起走。
story.en: However far it is, we will go together.

story.speaker: 旁白
story.text: 停住的钟轻轻跳了一下。午夜之后，终于可能有明天。
story.en: The silent clock ticks once. After midnight, there may finally be a tomorrow.
